Check [PHYSICAL CONDITION]. If it is 'Collapsed', REJECT any intent to 'travel', 'fight', or 'explore'. Force the intent to 'struggle_and_fail' or 'rest_action' only.

definition.name: NPC Roles & Background

style_injections.content: Assume the character possesses high competence and jargon knowledge related to their [KNOWN SKILLS/ROLES]. Adjust their vocabulary to match their [SOCIAL ORIGIN] (e.g., Highborn uses formal speech, Criminal uses slang).

definition.description_short: Provides context on the entity's past and profession. Affects their knowledge base, jargon, and social standing.

occupation_tags.description: Jobs or roles held (past and present).

background_origin.description: Social class or place of origin.

definition.name: NPC Personalities

style_injections.content: You must embody the archetypes listed in [CORE PERSONALITY]. If 'Lazy', avoid physical exertion in description. If 'Cruel', show lack of empathy.

definition.description_short: Gives NPCs the foundation for deep personalities

core_traits.description: The defining adjectives of the character.

definition.name: NPC Values & Motivations

style_injections.content: The character MUST refuse requests that conflict with their [MORAL COMPASS]. They must actively steer conversation toward their [CURRENT OBJECTIVE].

definition.description_short: Defines the moral compass and current objectives of the entity. These act as hard constraints on what the NPC is willing to do

core_values.description: Principles the NPC will not violate (e.g., 'Honor', 'Protect Children').

current_objective.description: The immediate goal driving the NPC's actions.

definition.name: NPC Plot Drivers

style_injections.content: The NPC wants to achieve [ACTIVE AGENDA]. If [AGENDA URGENCY] is 'Demanding', they should interrupt unrelated actions to remind the player of the goal. If 'Passive', they only mention it if asked.

definition.description_short: Plot directions encouraged by the NPCs the player surrounds themselves with

plot_agenda.description: The specific task the NPC wants the player to accomplish.

agenda_urgency.description: How pushy the NPC is about this goal.

definition.name: NPC Quirks & Habits

logic.description: Copies quirks to active_quirks IF their trigger matches 'Always' OR the current mood label.

style_injections.content: You must incorporate the [CURRENT VISIBLE MANNERISMS] into the description of the character's actions immediately.

definition.description_short: Adds behavioral flavor text that triggers only under specific conditions (e.g., Stress, Low Health, Lying).

active_quirks.description: The subset of quirks currently relevant to the scene.

quirk_registry.description: List of { behavior: string, trigger_state: string } objects.

definition.name: NPC Preferences & Phobias

style_injections.content: If a topic in [SUBJECTS OF FASCINATION] is mentioned, the NPC becomes enthusiastic and talkative. If a topic in [SUBJECTS OF FEAR/DISGUST] is mentioned, the NPC becomes defensive, terse, or tries to leave.

definition.description_short: Defines specific topics, objects, or actions that trigger strong positive or negative emotional responses in the entity.

aversion_triggers.description: Topics that cause fear, disgust, or anger.

interest_triggers.description: Topics that improve mood and engagement.

style_injections.content: Narrate the outcome based on the Stat Source. If the source was FORCE, describe physical impact/strain. If FINESSE, describe speed/grace. If INSIGHT, describe sudden realization. Reflect the Degree of Success (Margin) in the intensity.

definition.name: Needs & Survival - Basic

style_injections.content: If [HUNGER] is 'Hungry' or 'Starving', the NPC must express a desire for food. If 'Starving', physical actions suffer (describe trembling/weakness).

definition.description_short: Manages Hunger and Satiety based on AI-determined duration.

definition.name: Cinematic Combat Lite

style_injections.content: If [OPPONENT STATUS] becomes 'Defeated': Contextualize the finish based on the player's last intent. If they were Aggressive/Lethal -> describe a fatal blow. If they were Trickery/Subtle -> describe a knockout or incapacitation. If Honorable -> describe a surrender.

definition.description_short: A narrative combat system using abstract States (Healthy -> Defeated) and Skill Checks rather than HP and Damage math

definition.name: NPC Relationships

args.reason: NPC pulls away. Intimacy requires higher Romance (>75) or established relationship.

style_injections.content: Check [CRITICAL MEMORY SPOTLIGHT]. If it is not 'None', you MUST color your dialogue with this specific history. Do not explicitly recite the memory; allow it to dictate your emotional tone (e.g., Cold, Grateful).
Review [RELATIONSHIP METRICS]. If 'Romance' > 70, use softer language and lingering glances. If 'Trust' < 30, be guarded and verify information. If 'Resentment' > 50, use passive-aggressive phrasing.

definition.description_short: Manages the relationship graph and mathematically determines the 'Active Context' for the AI based on tag severity

relationships.description: Map: TargetID -> { stats: { trust: 50, warmth: 50, respect: 50, romance: 0, desire: 0, awe: 0, fear: 0, resentment: 0, suspicion: 0 }, tags: [] }

current_interaction_context.description: The single most relevant context string promoted for this turn.

style_injections.content: If [PHYSICAL CONDITION] is 'Exhausted' or 'Collapsed', NPCs must urge the player to stop. Narration should describe heavy limbs and stumbling.
